title: Dara knot wall hanging — white ribbon, bone-white fabric, copper M
purpose: README concept rendering based on the clean design reference.
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: README hero image for the existing Dara knot wall hanging.
Primary request: Render this EXACT wall-hanging design installed on a dark blue wall, with white knot ribbon, bone-white decorative woven fabric, and a copper manuscript M.
Input images: Image 1 (front CAD image) is the edit target and authoritative reference for the precise outlines, arrangement, scale, openings, and manuscript M silhouette. Image 2 (angled CAD image) is a supporting reference for the shallow relief and layered construction only.
Scene/backdrop: a plain matte dark navy blue painted interior wall with subtle fine texture. All large open spaces reveal the same navy wall. No furniture or props.
Subject: The referenced 36 x 36 inch square Dara knot wall hanging. Preserve all eight outer curved lobes, the exact ribbon routing, double rails, crossing arrangement, central gaps, negative spaces, and fabric inset footprints. Preserve the distinctive broad curved manuscript M exactly as shown: its two arching crescent-like outer strokes and straight central stem, not a conventional block M. The letter is a separate raised solid over the knot.
Materials/textures: All gray knot rails from the reference become clean satin white. All brown grid fabric insets become subtly warm bone-white woven fabric with clearly visible fine woven texture, fitted only in the existing narrow inset channels; keep the eight large outer photo openings empty. All beige letter surfaces become satin brushed metallic copper with warm reddish copper color, restrained realistic highlights and copper-colored edge faces. No gold or brass appearance. White ribbon and bone-white fabric must remain visibly distinct.
Style/medium: polished photorealistic 3D product visualization, precise faithful design, realistic shallow physical thickness and wall stand-off, soft contact shadows cast on wall.
Composition/framing: square composition, whole object visible, centered and upright, nearly straight-on front view so the geometry matches Image 1, generous even navy wall margin around all edges, no cropping.
Lighting/mood: soft natural light from upper left, gentle shadows below and to right, slight sheen on the copper with no blown highlights.
Constraints: Exact referenced design and proportions. Do not redesign or simplify the knot or replace the M. Do not fill empty openings with fabric, photographs, or extra backing. No visible mounting screws. No added text, dimension labels, borders, or watermark.
